text:
marie: quick sync 1 - seen noisy auto-fallbacks during quota bursts. ops can't tell which degrade mode (soft/partial/full) ran so they guess :grimacing:

dan: +1. propose a tiny badge on route: [soft], [proxy], [fallback] + a hover "why" giving machine reason codes and a one-line quota context.

reza: also need a conservative "operator nudge" button that creates an auditable override record (actor, reason code, preview_id, ttl). override should only apply if safety checks pass.

marie: safety checks = (error_delta <= 0.03) AND (p95_delta_pct <= 10%). blocked cases surface tooltip with metrics.

ops-bot: ci: autofallback-badge -> staging queued

dan: UX: badge timeline on the route header for last 15m, click opens side panel with snapshot id + 3 anonymized request samples and top error classes. preview runner returns estimated error/latency delta.

reza: API sketch (string proto in text): POST /v1/rollouts/{id}/operator-nudge { reason_code, ttl_secs, preview } -> returns preview_id then apply call posts audit.

marie: audit must include trace ids, snapshot pointer to telemetry, operator identity, session id, and retention policy (90d default, extendable for incidents).

dan: next steps: reza to spec API and preview runner limits, marie to mock badges and panel, i'll wire SDK + docs. small A/B: enable badges+preview on internal routes and track rollback reversals avoided. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
